capabilities: Pause other audio clips when a new one starts playing
Reset paused clips to the beginning instead of pausing
Cycle to the next or previous audio file in the active tab via hotkeys
Globally pause and resume audio with a single hotkey
Prevent keyboard focus on audio player elements
extras: Hotkeys are blank by default and must be assigned manually in Obsidian's hotkey settings.
problem: Obsidian lets multiple embedded audio clips play at once, forcing users to locate and manually pause each previous file.
summary: Audio playback manager that automatically pauses other playing clips when a new one starts, with hotkeys to cycle through and toggle audio.
